sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il sentiment di mercato è risk-off a causa dell'aumento delle tensioni geopolitiche e dell'inflazione. Il VIX è sopra i 20 e il DXY è forte, il che indica una maggiore avversione al rischio. Le borse asiatiche sono miste, mentre l'Europa è attesa aprire in positivo. Il petrolio è in calo, il che potrebbe essere visto come un fattore positivo per l'inflazione.
sentiment.reason_en: Market sentiment is risk-off due to rising geopolitical tensions and inflation concerns. VIX is above 20 and DXY is strong, indicating increased risk aversion. Asian markets are mixed, while Europe is expected to open positive. Oil is down, which could be seen as a positive factor for inflation.

market_impact_summary.it: I mercati sono influenzati dalle tensioni geopolitiche e dall'inflazione. Il S&P 500 è sceso dell'1,62% e il VIX è salito al 20,63. Il DXY è forte a 100,09 e il petrolio è in calo a 92,49 dollari al barile. Le borse europee sono attese aprire in positivo.
market_impact_summary.en: Markets are impacted by geopolitical tensions and inflation concerns. S&P 500 down 1.62% and VIX up to 20.63. DXY strong at 100.09 and oil down to $92.49 per barrel. European markets expected to open positive.

audio_script_it:
Buongiorno, benvenuti al Morning Briefing di Price Alert.


Il Nikkei ha chiuso in rialzo dello 0.06%, Shanghai in calo dello 0.16%. Questo suggerisce un'apertura positiva per i mercati europei.


Sul fronte dei mercati occidentali, nella seduta precedente, l'S&P 500 ha chiuso in calo dell'1.62%, il VIX è sceso del 7.16%, segnale di riduzione dell'avversione al rischio. Il DXY è salito dello 0.14%, mentre l'oro è in rialzo dello 0.12%, raggiungendo i 4113 dollari l'oncia. Il petrolio è sceso dello 0.66%, a 92.49 dollari. Il rendimento del decennale USA è salito dello 0.31%, al 4.54%. Il BTP 10Y italiano è stabile al 3.73%.


Sul fronte geopolitico, la Cina ha aumentato i prezzi alla produzione di fabbrica al ritmo più veloce in quasi 4 anni, il che potrebbe avere implicazioni per l'inflazione globale. Inoltre, le tensioni commerciali tra Cina e Bruxelles si sono intensificate, con Pechino che ha sospeso due incontri.


Nessun dato macro rilevante in uscita oggi.

Passiamo ora al comparto degli asset digitali. Bitcoin si mantiene sopra i sessantamila dollari, con un aumento del 2,60% nella giornata. Tuttavia, i flussi ETF hanno registrato una significativa uscita netta di 213,9 milioni di dollari. Questo movimento potrebbe essere influenzato da una generale avversione al rischio degli investitori.

Anche le principali altcoin mostrano variazioni positive: Ethereum guadagna il 2,22% arrivando a mille seicentosessantanove dollari, Solana sale del 3,08% a sessantacinque virgola trentanove dollari e BNB aumenta del 2,65% raggiungendo i seicento dollari.

Il Fear & Greed Index è a 12, nella zona di Extreme Fear, suggerisce cautela sugli investitori.

Nessun dato macro in agenda oggi. Per approfondire i temi di oggi, sulla nostra piattaforma trovate gli articoli completi nella sezione Storie in Primo Piano. Grazie per l'attenzione e a domani.
audio_script_en: Good morning, welcome to the Price Alert Morning Briefing. The Nikkei closed up 0.06%, while Shanghai fell 0.16%, suggesting a positive opening for European markets. In the previous session, the S&P 500 closed down 1.62%, and the VIX dropped 7.16%, a sign of reduced risk aversion. The DXY rose 0.14%, while gold is up 0.12%, reaching $4,113 per ounce. Oil fell 0.66% to $92.49 The 10-year US yield rose 0.31% to 4.54%. The Italian 10Y BTP is stable at 3.73%. On the geopolitical front, China increased factory gate prices at the fastest pace in nearly 4 years, which could have implications for global inflation. Additionally, trade tensions between China and Brussels have intensified, with Beijing suspending two meetings. No major macroeconomic data is due today. Let's pivot to the cryptocurrency markets. Bitcoin remains above sixty thousand dollars, with a 2.6% increase today. However, ETF flows have recorded a significant net outflow of $213.9 million. This movement could be influenced by a general risk aversion among investors. Major altcoins also show positive variations: Ethereum gains 2.22% to $1,669, Solana rises 3.08% to $65.39, and BNB increases 2.65% to $600 The Fear & Greed Index is at 12, in the Extreme Fear zone, suggesting caution among investors. No macroeconomic data is scheduled for today. For a deeper dive into today's topics, find the full articles in the Top Stories section on our platform. Thank you for your attention, and we'll see you tomorrow.

articles.title: Dusting a Dirt Road: How The United States Can Break the Cycle of Failing Military Infrastructure
articles.snippet: Winter Storm Uri ripped through Texas in January 2021. The frigid temperatures froze pipes, which then burst and caused flooding in aging barracks at Fort Hood, many of which were overdue for renovations and had vulnerable mechanical and utility systems. The burst pipes, damaged sprinkler systems, and frozen heating, ventilation, and air conditioning coils affected over 30 barracks, forcing soldiers to relocate and causing nearly $50 million in damage.According to the Department of Defense’s reporting, the United States owns and operates more than 700,000 facilities across nearly 5,000 sites at home and abroad. articles.title: Why Is Europe’s Economy Falling Short?
articles.snippet: For much of the postwar era, European policymakers have prioritized stability and predictability over fostering breakthrough innovation. Today, as the United States and China compete for AI dominance, a stagnant Europe is struggling to regain its place at the technological frontier.

articles.title: Peak Oil Demand Has Arrived
articles.snippet: Amid the disruptions caused by the US/Israeli-Iran war, countries have begun adapting to life with less oil. What started as a supply shock has become a demand story, forcing the energy sector to reconsider one of its most important assumptions: continued growth of global oil demand.

articles.title: The Chain of Peace: Do Supply Chain Chokepoints Deter War?
articles.snippet: The next war over Taiwan may be deterred not by aircraft carriers or nuclear arsenals, but by a Dutch lithography machine. ASML, headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, is the sole manufacturer of the extreme ultraviolet lithography systems required to produce the world’s most advanced semiconductors. Without its machines, the most sophisticated foundries on earth — including those of the Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC) — cannot operate. This fact should be at the center of how the United States thinks about deterrence in the Indo-Pacific. articles.title: The Flip Side
articles.snippet: A more challenging corporate credit backdrop may not be entirely a bad thing. In the latest episode of The Insight: Conversations , we flip the script and consider the opportunities that may arise from a less easy lending environment. Brook Hinchman (Head of North America, Global Opportunities) and Matt Wilson (Co-Portfolio Manager, Special Situations) discuss interest rates, the U.S. consumer, rescue loans, liability management exercises, and much more.

articles.title: Japan Taps Reserves and New Suppliers to Beat the Oil Blockade
articles.snippet: Despite the Hormuz crisis, Japan has secured the same volumes of oil imports for July as it did a year ago, as it is boosting imports from producers not dependent on the Strait to deliver their crude, sources familiar with the procurement plans told Kyodo News on Thursday. Resource-poor Japan is one of the biggest energy importers globally and relied on the Middle East for as much as 95% of its oil imports before the war broke out. articles.title: Fold Holdings Dumps $45M in Bitcoin to Wipe Out Debt, Stock Briefly Pumps Over 130%
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Magazine Fold Holdings Dumps $45M in Bitcoin to Wipe Out Debt, Stock Briefly Pumps Over 130% Fold Holdings sold roughly $45 million worth of bitcoin to eliminate secured debt and fund growth initiatives, leaving the company with a debt-free secured balance sheet, a treasury of 1,492 BTC, and renewed focus on expanding its Bitcoin rewards and financial services products. This post Fold Holdings Dumps $45M in Bitcoin to Wipe Out Debt, Stock Briefly Pumps Over 130% first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
